cards.title: Angular CLI Basics
cards.content:
Angular CLI

The Angular CLI is a command-line interface tool that you use to initialize, develop, scaffold, and maintain Angular applications.

npm install -g @angular/cli
ng new my-app

cards.title: Generating Files
cards.content:
Scaffolding Code

Use ng generate (or ng g) to create components, services, and more.

ng generate component header
ng g s user

cards.title: Serve and Build
cards.content:
Serving and Building

ng serve builds the app and starts a local dev server. ng build compiles the app into an output directory for deployment.

ng serve --open
ng build --configuration production

content.prompt: Write a JavaScript function that returns the Angular CLI command to start the development server.
